user_story: As a user, I want to navigate to HTTP status code pages so that I can understand the meaning of various HTTP status codes. Acceptance Criteria: When I visit the URL 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/status_codes', I should see the heading 'Status Codes' and be able to click on status codes 200, 301, 404, and 500 which are represented as links. The element with ID 'flash-messages' should remain visible throughout my interaction.
